name: fiducial_grasp_onsite_20261120
tolerance_basis: Measured 46-grasp tolerance envelope, conservative worst side 6 mm; the 2 deg rotation gate is still provisional.

sources.notes: Held-out final base error from the 14-pose bus-servo hand-eye dataset (3.29 mm); the same dataset reports 3.41 mm leave-one-out std. Treated as a bound, not a Gaussian sigma.
Held-out final base rotation error (0.43 deg); treated as a bound.
Worst of 15/15 semi-synthetic poses on real camera frames; the marker was composited, not physically present. This is a relative-pose detection error.
Worst semi-synthetic rotation error (0.53 deg); treated as a bound.
30 visits to the grasp pose [0, -0.6618, -1.8012, -0.3917, 0], AprilTag-observed. Radial RMS 0.449 mm, radial max 1.017 mm; the measured joints repeat to 0-1 pulse.
Max geodesic deviation of the tag frame from the mean over the same 30 visits; mean 0.446 deg.
15 forward + 15 reverse visits to the same pose from joint4 +/-0.1 rad. Hysteresis vector (-0.971, -0.064, -0.549) mm, magnitude 1.117 mm; joint4 settles 10 pulses apart.

Commanded joint vector vs bus-servo registers at the grasp pose, mapped through the same KDL model. Mean 4.220 mm, SD 0.628 mm, max 5.386 mm over 20 grasps. The offset is systematic (joint1/joint2 settle 4 pulses from the command); the constant correction was fitted with it present.
Geodesic rotation between the commanded and the measured grasp frame. Mean 1.069 deg, SD 0.207 deg, max 1.495 deg over the same 20 grasps.

Landing minus pre-grasp measurement over 20 successful put-backs. Mean 3.080 mm, SD 2.748 mm, RMS 4.082 mm, max 11.514 mm; mean xy bias (-0.987, +1.634) mm. This is a task-level release/placement outcome and overlaps the execution term; the max is used as a conservative bound.

Operator lifted and re-placed the cube on the yellow tape 20 times; top-face point spread about its mean. Radial RMS 5.057 mm, max 14.815 mm; per-axis SD (5.112, 0.884, 0.362) mm. The tape has no x-direction stop, so the x scatter dominates. Three off-tape placements were excluded and kept as discarded evidence.

limitations: The execution offset is systematic and the constant correction was fitted with it present; the component RSS and the corrected task outcome answer different questions.
Gripper placement is a task-level landing displacement, not a pure release term; it overlaps execution and the residual correction.
The object-fixture term is a nuisance in this pipeline because every trial re-measures the cube at the view pose; the fixture-inclusive report shows it separately.
The measured values are maxima over one session, treated as bounds like the calibration terms.
The 2 deg rotation tolerance is a provisional protocol gate, not a measured physical tolerance.
